title: Scalar normalization of ordinary integral derived pullback
statement: For a morphism f:X→Y of schemes, commutative coefficient ring sheaves R on Y and S on X, and an isomorphism from the inverse image of R to S, ordinary derived ringed pullback followed by restriction of scalars along this coefficient isomorphism is naturally isomorphic to the raw adic tower inverse image. The assertion is existence of this natural isomorphism; it makes no chart, perfectness or completeness assumption.

source.place: Tag 03D8 (pullback composition), and lemma-adjoint-push-pull-modules (inverse image adjunction). Apply uniqueness of left adjoints.

proof.text: Scalar restriction along the inverse-image coefficient isomorphism is an exact equivalence. Compose its inverse adjunction with the raw inverse image adjunction. The right adjoints are sectionwise identical. Uniqueness of left adjoints gives the ordinary module comparison. Apply the exact-functor derived natural-isomorphism and composition comparisons, including the identity-coefficient case.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtaleRingDerivedPullback_scalarComparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R ≅ S) :
    Nonempty (proEtaleRingDerivedPullback f R S c ⋙
      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
        ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).map c.hom)).mapDerivedCategory ≅
        adicTowerPullback f R)
